description: Gojiberry brings your outbound sales workflow into ChatGPT. Search a directory of B2B leads and companies with free masked previews, reveal full records, and enrich contacts with verified emails and mobile phone numbers. Organize contacts into lists, create and manage outreach campaigns, review campaign logs, configure lead-sourcing Agents, and read and reply to conversations in your unified inbox - all through natural language. Requires a Gojiberry account and API key from app.gojiberry.ai.

defaultPrompt: Find 20 marketing directors at SaaS companies in Paris and save them to a new list
Enrich my latest contacts with verified emails and check the results
Show me my active campaigns and summarize recent replies in my inbox
